profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Infinera
profile.summary: SKILLS:	  Networking and realtime embedded system--  Linux & RTOSs:  QNX, VxWorks, PSOS+, ThreadX, WOK (HP’s RTOS).  Archictect, design and hardware bring up systems in Assembly, C, and C++.  Systems--  DCI 100GbE optical transport appliance, Network Content Security Appliance, SAN Switches, Telecomm SONET & DWDM optical network transport & crossed connect systems, LAN Gigabit Ethernet switches, ATM and FDDI brigdes, Home Wireless Networks,  Graphics Print Engine.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Data Center Interconnect (DCI) Cloud Xpress 10GbE, 40GbE, 100GbE to DWDM optical linux based transport platforms. 
Project lead for several digital to optical DWDM 40G 100G line modules ( QNX RTOS based optical transport systems)

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Developed drivers and control softwares for DSP, ASICs and 100Gbe framers on digital to optical transport line modules.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed software for Network Security linux based appliance box.  Worked on HW accelerator virus and spam scanners.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed platform software and driver for SAN Storage solutions.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead a team to developed drivers and platform software on VxWorks RTOS for DWDM optical transport systems.
